Class ResponseBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.studiomediatech.queryresponse.ResponseBuilder
public class ResponseBuilder extends Object
The main entry type for response building, provides static factory methods to create a chaining response builder.

  • Method Details

    • respondTo

      public <T> ChainingResponseBuilder<T> respondTo(String term, Class<T> type)
      Creates a new chaining response-builder for the given query-term, and the published type of elements.
      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the response elements, and the type argument.
      Parameters:
      term - the query to respond to. A String of up to 255 characters.
      type - of response elements. Any Java type of class that is published as JSON responses. This will infer the type of the provided elements.
      Returns:
      a new ChainingResponseBuilder instance, never null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the response query term argument is invalid.
